status: Historical controller-scoped validation; superseded by docs/show103/task-failure/review.json. No learning performed.
failure_scope: Historical scope only: controller_failed. Current runtime settles task_failed (grasp deadline or outside-bowl table landing); see current review.
termination: Historical controller-failure settlement was replaced. Current controller interruptions remain separately logged and do not receive task-failure tail settlement.
formula: future settlement = -c*sum(gamma**k for k in1..remaining); current failure-step cost is separate;gamma=.99 matches PPO.
failed_step_actual_costs: Action/action-rate/impact/contact costs on the failure step retained once; no fictitious future success reward credited.
repeated_calls: failure_settled guard prevents duplicate settlement even if a caller steps a terminal state without resetting.
guards: last finite-horizon reward included in GAE

gpu_validation.note: Finite controller-failure injection tests bookkeeping; no hardware failure or policy training.

limitations: Return equivalence is for the specified fixed failure-cost continuation, not equivalence to a recoverable physical trajectory.
GAE(lambda<1), critic-loss variance and gradient distribution need separate validation before learning; tail settlement may be hundreds of reward units.
Injected controller failures validate reset accounting, not learned task success or a throughput benchmark.
implementation_note: An attempted native absorbing-physics branch was not retained; runtime uses one ordinary vectorized step then fast AutoReset. Absorbing helper is a CPU-only numerical reference.
